groups.review: Same SMM APT daily average in USD/tonne for the same timestamp; strict thresholds. Formal corrections within 24h and delayed/missing publication provisions apply; first publication alone is not final.

markets.rules_primary: If the daily average price of APT tungsten (SMM-WU-APT-001) as published by Shanghai Metals Market (SMM) at 5:00 PM ET on Oct 30, 2026 is above $40,000/tonne, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: This market resolves based on the daily average price of APT tungsten (SMM-WU-APT-001) as published by Shanghai Metals Market (SMM). The governing value is the Average figure SMM publishes for the assessment dated 5:00 PM ET on Oct 30, 2026, which is the midpoint of SMM's assessed High and Low for that day; the High and Low do not themselves govern. The price is taken in USD per tonne exactly as published by SMM, with no conversion or adjustment by Kalshi. SMM publishes on Chinese business days; if no assessment is published for the specified date, the COMMODITIES rules on missing and delayed publications apply. Kalshi is not affiliated with Shanghai Metals Market.

groups.review: Same worldwide UTC-day maximum USGS magnitude; at-least thresholds. Only reviewed ComCat events qualify; withdrawals and revisions before expiration matter. Automatic first alerts do not settle the market.

markets.rules_primary: If the highest USGS-reported earthquake magnitude worldwide during Sep 24, 2026 from 12:00:00 AM through 11:59:59 PM UTC is 5.2 or higher, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: The determining value is the USGS-reported magnitude displayed at Expiration, preferentially moment magnitude (Mw) and otherwise the primary magnitude type reported by USGS. If multiple earthquakes tie for the highest magnitude, all tied earthquakes count. If USGS ComCat is unavailable at Expiration, settlement may be delayed under the Contract contingencies.

groups.review: Same September 2026 all-items CPI-U nonseasonally adjusted 12-month percent change, one decimal BLS report; strict thresholds. Missing-data formula and shutdown extension apply. Trading closes at 8:29 AM ET before the scheduled release.

markets.rules_primary: If the Consumer Price Index (CPI) increases by more than 3.0% in the twelve months ending September 2026 (as represented by the one-decimal place value reported by the Bureau of Labor Statistics), then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
In the case of a delay in data caused by a federal government shutdown impacting the reliability of the Source Agency, the market’s latest Expiration Date will be extended to the sooner of the release of the Underlying or six months after the end of the
government shutdown
